Package aor.proj3t.util.validatorutils.fordto

Class UserValidator

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.validatorutils.fordto.UserValidator
@ApplicationScoped public class UserValidator extends Object
Validator class for user-related input and DTO validation.

This utility provides centralized methods for verifying the correctness of user registration data, profiles, contact information, role assignment, and authentication credentials. It ensures consistency and enforces constraints before the data reaches service or persistence layers.
